# proxcenter_vdc (Data Source)

One vDC the token sees, with its nodes, storages, quota and usage. Needs vms:read or vdcs:read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxcenter_vdc" "prod" {
  name = "prod"
}

output "nodes" {
  value = data.proxcenter_vdc.prod.nodes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) vDC id. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) vDC name. Set id or name.

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) Cluster connection the vDC lives on; the connection_id of its VMs.
- `nodes` (List of String) Nodes the vDC may place VMs on; target_node of a proxcenter_vm.
- `pool` (String) Proxmox resource pool of the vDC.
- `primary_storage` (String) Default storage of the vDC.
- `quota` (Attributes) Quota; a null limit is unlimited. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quota))
- `storages` (List of String) Storages the vDC may use.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant the vDC belongs to.
- `usage` (Attributes) Usage computed by ProxCenter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage))

<a id="nestedatt--quota"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quota`

Read-Only:

- `max_ram_mb` (Number) Memory limit, MiB.
- `max_storage_mb` (Number) Storage limit, MiB.
- `max_vcpus` (Number) vCPU limit.
- `max_vms` (Number) Guest count limit.


<a id="nestedatt--usage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage`

Read-Only:

- `used_ram_mb` (Number) Memory in use, MiB.
- `used_storage_mb` (Number) Storage in use, MiB.
- `used_vcpus` (Number) vCPUs in use.
- `used_vms` (Number) Guests in the vDC.
